subject: Delivery timing
text: Can the delivery be left on the porch if I am not in? I know this is a last-minute complication, since I forgot the gate stays locked until I get home, but I can give the courier a temporary code if that is safer. The package is only a blanket and two small jars, so it does not need special handling. I also would not want anyone to be stuck at your door. If leaving it outside feels too risky, tell me a better drop-off time, even a narrow one. I can be flexible and do not mind if this changes your evening. Just let me know what works for you.
